Class OnlineClient

java.lang.Object
Business.Entities.OnlineClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Customer
public class OnlineClient extends Object implements Customer
Represents a client who shops online and requires home delivery. Extends the Customer contract with a shipping address and contact email.

Each order carries a one-time shipping surcharge of €2 + €0.01 per km from the La Salle campus (shipment origin) to the client's delivery address, computed by getShippingCost(). Per-item prices are not adjusted; the surcharge is added to the cart total at checkout time.

Online clients cannot purchase Service products, as services require the customer to be physically present at the store.

  • Method Details

    • getPricingStrategy

      public double getPricingStrategy()
      Returns 1.0: online clients pay the full VAT-inclusive product price with no per-item discount or surcharge. The shipping surcharge is a one-time order-level addition returned by getShippingCost() and added to the cart total at checkout time.
      Specified by:
      getPricingStrategy in interface Customer
      Returns:
      always 1.0

    • getShippingCost

      public double getShippingCost()
      Calculates the one-time shipping cost for this client's order. Uses the geolocation API to determine the distance from the La Salle campus (shipment origin) to the client's shipping address, then applies €2 + €0.01 per km.

      Returns 0.0 if the address is unset or the geolocation lookup fails.

      Specified by:
      getShippingCost in interface Customer
      Returns:
      the shipping surcharge in euros
